task_description: Finish the VayuLok map + selected-place experience to the final owner-approved design on branch vayulok-selected-place-final. Reconcile the spec against the current stack: deck.gl real-sample AQ dots, the no-raster removal, the bottom destination bar, two-column layout, left card, India autocomplete, geocoding import, and the transparent-inactive/translucent-lime-active pills are ALREADY present and correct - verify, do not rebuild. The genuine remaining work: remove Dawki as a visible default (separate initial camera from selected destination, selectedPlace starts null), hard India country validation on reverse-geocode/geocoding/SearchDestinations, a custom no-red selected marker, left-card hero photo + bottom notch, the photo-fallback fix, the open/closed metadata audit, and a final pill/token pass. Implement the full behavioral test matrix A-O. Honest degradation, no red, and Google attribution are hard constraints enforced by a semantic reviewer.

verification.summary: Final state after the v1 semantic review (APPROVED) and a post-review cleanup commit. typecheck clean (0 errors); npm run lint 0 errors (204 repo-wide warnings, all pre-existing patterns incl. one new no-img-element warning on the hero , consistent with the existing warnings); full npm run test 946 passed / 3 skipped / 0 failed (74 test files). VayuLokLive.test.tsx 45/45, covering matrix A-O behaviorally plus E3. Verified new tests E/E2/E3 (scripted BD-then-IN reverse-geocode: BD rejected, IN fallback accepted; BD-only selects nothing and surfaces an honest outside-India status; a stale outside-India status is cleared after a later valid IN click), K (reads back the real marker icon data-URI and asserts dark-green/lime/white hexes and NO red), and N (deliberate AQI 320 + pm25 20 payload proves the PM2.5 dot fill and left result are concentration-driven, not AQI-derived) - each drives real state/handlers and would fail if the behavior were reverted. Regression scan: no active ImageMapType/raster path, no active red color tokens, no CSS targeting .gm-style-cc / a[href*=google] / img[alt=Google], destbar + deck.gl overlay stay inset (bottom:36px) clear of Google legal. npm run build NOT run: it chains generator scripts + a full Next static export that is heavy, env-dependent, and unrelated to this client component change; per context.json the agreed gate falls back to typecheck+lint+test, all green. The live map/dots/autocomplete cannot render in sandbox (referrer-restricted key) - verification is the stubbed-google + honest-degradation path, as designed.
